body.heading: Paint one side
paragraphs: Fold your paper in half, then open it. Paint blobs and swirls on one side only.
Work fairly quickly so the paint stays wet and ready to print.

body.heading: Fold and peek
paragraphs: Fold the clean side over the paint and press gently all over with your hands.
Open it slowly. Your painting has doubled itself into wings.

takeaway: Folding paint in half makes both sides match, like a butterfly's wings.
safetyNotes: An adult helps with the folding while the paint is wet; wash hands afterwards.
screenFreeExtension: Fold-paint a flower, a face, or a whole row of butterflies.
